booleans-on-swept-carriers.label: Boolean algebra over lofted/swept/revolved (non-canonical-carrier) geometry
booleans-on-swept-carriers.note: Canonical-by-canonical booleans are landed. PB-011 routes the funnel-supported swept-carrier pairs (spline/swept/revolved carrier classes, the CFP-004 stage contract) through the facade's certified-entry dispatch at the bridge. PB-011B (the 2-D path wave) lifted the 12 canonical-cutter F1 rows: each row's OCC-baseline harness door run is green and its facts match the recorded reference (evidence marker PB-011B LIFT EVIDENCE in the row note), and the four corner rows carry no revolved-circle (torus) carrier in the op path, so no typed torus refusal was recorded; the rows keep this machine-checked reason until the orchestrator's corpus-output step moves them to the runnable canonical set (same protocol as the PB-011 falcon_heavy/cutaway lift). The F1 rows whose first refusing op is swept x swept (airbox, beam_wing, details, drivetrain, drs_flap, engine_cover, power_unit, rear_wing) were PB-011C's 4-D path wave. PB-011C ran all eight on this dispatch and NONE certifies - a typed-refusal census row each: every row's swept-carrier booleans are swept x swept (lofted/swept base x lofted/swept tool) carrier pairs the certified funnel does not admit end to end today (the fuse(swept,swept)/cut(swept,swept) pair cells answer the typed constructive-carrier NonCanonicalCarrier refusal at the boolean boundary; no landed boolean runs between two spline-loft solids; the restricted 4-D arm admits circular-section sweeps only, so no solver budget is spent - a typed refusal, not a stagnation), each row note carries a PB-011C CENSUS typed-refusal record with its OCC-baseline door evidence (green, facts reproducing the recorded reference within tolerance; facts mismatch: none), and no row carries a lift marker. The census records which rows refused and books the next funnel program's 4-D admission; the rows stay staged under this reason. A pair coupling a swept carrier with a funnel-refused class (torus - a revolved-circle carrier) stays a typed refusal (ContactReductionDeferred) and is recorded in the row's note, never lifted. This reason row remains the machine-checked evidence for the rows still staged, resolving to the BIE program's sweep-pair certification (BIE-006).
